name: create-backon
description: Scaffolds a new backend project on backon — like `bun create vite@latest`, but for a consistent controller/routes/services backend layout. Runs via bunx/bun create or npx/npm create.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --packages=external --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --outfile=dist/cli.js && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
